_note: Built-in clinical preset. Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:clinical and VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=critical so allergies/meds are always injected. Meds and code status are confirm-gated (a change needs human approval); allergies are NOT gated because surfacing a new allergy is safety-positive and must be immediate.

slots.description: resuscitation preference — full code, DNR, DNI
